Scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 他：zero form, In the same sentence, 神农 is already the subject, so omit the repeated pronoun: 神农不知道吃的是灵芝还是夹竹桃. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 他：∅，The embedded subject is the same person as 神农 in the same sentence, so use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 他：∅，The subject is already “神农” in the same sentence, so omit the repeated pronoun when the same person performs the embedded action. [rule: none]

output.reason: All runs flag the repeated pronoun 他, but Run 1 changes the meaning to identifying what he ate rather than whether he should eat it.
